purpose: Build an auditable Johor Bahru historical flood-event and road-impact database for evidence-driven healthcare accessibility disruption modelling.

C1_SHORT_DURATION_HEAVY_RAIN.quantitative_rule: rainfall intensity >20 mm/hour where official hourly observations are available
C1_SHORT_DURATION_HEAVY_RAIN.proxy_rule: If numeric hourly rainfall is unavailable, official JKR/agency classification as BANJIR KILAT may be used only as a flash-flood proxy; it does NOT create a numeric rainfall value.

C2_URBAN_INUNDATION.rule: Official/reputable evidence of road, residential, neighbourhood or urban surface inundation / flash flooding / waterlogging.

C3_ROAD_IMPASSABILITY_GENERAL_CAR.rule: JKR status T (road closed) OR B3 (open to heavy vehicles only) is treated as impassable to ordinary private cars.
C3_ROAD_IMPASSABILITY_GENERAL_CAR.partial_impairment: B1 = one lane open; retained as passable-but-impaired and not assigned an arbitrary speed penalty until calibrated.

C4_COMPOUND_DRIVERS.rule: River danger exceedance and/or high tide are stored as causal/contextual modifiers, not substitutes for direct road-impact evidence.

scenario_admission_rule: A road edge may enter an observed closure scenario only when road-specific evidence supports closure/impassability. Area-level flood reports alone cannot automatically close nearby roads.
population_accessibility_mode: general private car; emergency-vehicle behaviour must be modelled separately.
